bugs.what: Tower Shadow area navigation confusion — when heading east from Sodden Verge toward the watchtower, the location name stayed 'Tower Shadow' but I wasn't actually at the tower. Took trial-and-error to find the actual 'Old Watchtower' location.

confusions: The notice board dumps a lot of exposition at once — good info but dense. Could have been revealed more gradually.
Initial character selection screen has different flavor text for each class but doesn't clearly explain that the Scholar gets a special 'recall verse' action. I only discovered it by trying it.
Tower area geography is unclear — 'Tower Shadow' and 'Old Watchtower' are separate but the connection/exits aren't obvious.
suggestions: Add subtle directional hints in room descriptions when multiple exits lead toward the same landmark (e.g., 'the watchtower looms east' when you're close).
Break up the notice board into shorter chunks or let the player ask follow-up questions to dig deeper rather than one wall of text.
Make Scholar verse-recall mechanics more obvious in the character description or first verse interaction.
Consider showing a mini-map or clearer exit descriptions in the dense forest areas to reduce backtracking.
The game ending is satisfying but the barrow doors standing open felt unresolved given the reeve's emphasis on sealing them — maybe acknowledge that choice more explicitly.
